exam.title: Accelerating Sales Pipelines with AI in Dynamics 365
exam.study_prerequisites: Intermediate Microsoft Power Platform configuration, Dynamics 365 Sales and lead-to-cash process knowledge, model-driven app and Dataverse experience, and the ability to build Power Automate cloud flows.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Configure Dynamics 365 Sales core features for AI
Qualify and prioritize leads by using AI
Develop deals by using intelligent opportunity research

review.notes: Every subobjective on the official June 18, 2026 guide is mapped to a lead-to-cash record/process, configuration choice, data/security/collaboration boundary, intelligence or agent contract, capacity and monitoring control, channel or extension decision, evidence, failure or recovery path. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover the complete published scope. All 17 URLs are cataloged: 15 reachable and two Udemy pages access-blocked. The September 7 watch documents the volatile Sales agent roster, preview consumption boundary, Sales Close Agent cutoff/removal and migration path, Power Platform deprecations, and roadmap transition.

findings.title: Opportunity Agent custom-field support is internally contradictory
findings.evidence: The research section denies support and immediately describes adding Opportunity/related custom fields.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Close Agent stop semantics conflict across official pages
findings.evidence: Management says in-process records stop; setup says existing orchestration continues.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Existing transition citation pointed to wrong month
findings.evidence: July skilling announcement supports MB-280 to AB-210; fetched August page covers other replacements.
findings.recommendation: Correct the citation and remove uncorroborated course-component replacement wording.
findings.resolution: Correct the citation and remove uncorroborated course-component replacement wording.

findings.title: Markup, margin, currency and catalog privileges affect pricing
findings.evidence: Pricing methods distinguish cost markup and selling-price margin.
findings.recommendation: Add original price arithmetic and catalog privilege boundary.
findings.resolution: Add original price arithmetic and catalog privilege boundary.

findings.title: Record allowances and agent consumption are different meters
findings.evidence: Current licensing separates sequence/scored record limits and agent credits.
findings.recommendation: Separate allowances, tenant allocation and hypothetical capacity assumptions.
findings.resolution: Separate allowances, tenant allocation and hypothetical capacity assumptions.

findings.title: Assignment is ordered and capacity is scoped
findings.evidence: First matching rule, postactivation records and entity-configured capacity determine assignment.
findings.recommendation: Add rule-order and capacity example with polling/backlog constraints.
findings.resolution: Add rule-order and capacity example with polling/backlog constraints.

findings.title: Older collaboration/intelligence demonstrations contain removed features
findings.evidence: Native Exchange integration, forecast snapshots, document summary and channel linking changed.
findings.recommendation: Add current dependency and deprecation distinctions.
findings.resolution: Add current dependency and deprecation distinctions.

findings.title: Agent handoff is distinct from CRM lead qualification
findings.evidence: New record-creation choices include configured multiple opportunities.
findings.recommendation: Explain separate process events and custom-app form requirement.
findings.resolution: Explain separate process events and custom-app form requirement.

findings.title: Training eligibility depends on filtered history
findings.evidence: Forty outcomes of each class must be created and closed in chosen period; abandoned selected processes excluded.
findings.recommendation: Add filtered-count example, synchronization and model-versus-record timing.
findings.resolution: Add filtered-count example, synchronization and model-versus-record timing.

findings.title: Research-only can draft and stop does not cancel all work
findings.evidence: Synchronization supports drafts; upgrade direction and continuing in-flight leads documented.
findings.recommendation: Add deployment and containment boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add deployment and containment boundaries.

findings.title: Selected handoff criteria form a gate
findings.evidence: Selected purchase interest and BANT must both pass.
findings.recommendation: Add intersection example and supported custom-criteria boundary.
findings.resolution: Add intersection example and supported custom-criteria boundary.

findings.title: Research-only handoffs do not certify customer fit
findings.evidence: Test procedure documents handoff after research/drafting regardless of fit.
findings.recommendation: Correct measurement assumptions and add controlled inbox/public-company tests.
findings.resolution: Correct measurement assumptions and add controlled inbox/public-company tests.

findings.title: Opportunity instances share knowledge and consumption
findings.evidence: Current setup supports ten active instances and may configure predictive scoring.
findings.recommendation: Add instance/scope controls and separate hypothetical capacity example.
findings.resolution: Add instance/scope controls and separate hypothetical capacity example.

findings.title: Retiring Close Agent remains in exam scope
findings.evidence: New instances cease September 30 and existing instances are removed October 30.
findings.recommendation: Preserve historical objectives and replace new-deployment lab assumptions.
findings.resolution: Preserve historical objectives and replace new-deployment lab assumptions.

findings.title: Named replacement has separate preview prerequisites
findings.evidence: Development activation requires Frontier and Agent 365 setup and cautions against production preview use.
findings.recommendation: Qualify migration and plan continuity without automatic-parity assumptions.
findings.resolution: Qualify migration and plan continuity without automatic-parity assumptions.

findings.title: Completed engagement is not booked revenue
findings.evidence: Run, follow-up, loss and escalation states have distinct meanings.
findings.recommendation: Add timeline and seller-review checkpoints.
findings.resolution: Add timeline and seller-review checkpoints.

findings.title: Uploaded sales research requires currency context
findings.evidence: Connected Dynamics uses base currency while file/Fabric inference needs explicit context.
findings.recommendation: Add independent currency reconciliation and role/consent checks.
findings.resolution: Add independent currency reconciliation and role/consent checks.

findings.title: Dialer changes can affect existing telephony
findings.evidence: Teams dialer changes CIF coexistence and has app/entity/role limitations.
findings.recommendation: Add coexistence test and separate removed Sales Hub preview.
findings.resolution: Add coexistence test and separate removed Sales Hub preview.

findings.title: Sending alone does not verify SMS integration
findings.evidence: Inbound, delivery report, unique number and ownership configuration are distinct.
findings.recommendation: Add controlled reply/receipt/opt-out checks.
findings.resolution: Add controlled reply/receipt/opt-out checks.

findings.title: Mobile profile and cloud determine experience
findings.evidence: Sovereign/on-premises exclusions and offline/tablet Unified Interface behavior documented.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit deployment prerequisites and test boundary.
findings.resolution: Add explicit deployment prerequisites and test boundary.

findings.title: January blog setup and labels need current qualification
findings.evidence: Current form-fill guidance moves settings and retains product-specific limits.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded article exercise and preserve protected-column/file exclusions.
findings.resolution: Add bounded article exercise and preserve protected-column/file exclusions.

findings.title: Learn runtime is historical and paid listings remain unverified
findings.evidence: Current four paths expose 13 modules without the old runtime; two Udemy requests blocked.
findings.recommendation: Qualify runtime and paid catalog evidence instead of declaring current coverage.
findings.resolution: Qualify runtime and paid catalog evidence instead of declaring current coverage.

Both Udemy pages access-blocked; paid content, question originality, runtime and complete current exam coverage not reverified. Partner shell does not verify sessions.
Two public blog main articles read; videos, technical benchmark implementation and experimental results not reproduced. Historical release dates are not tenant availability.
Licensing source reviewed only for relevant Sales sections; no full licensing/legal audit or live cost/rate quote.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent human review pending.
